text: Jakariyaa maaki (yo o his): "Ko an yo Jooma, waɗanam maande nde miɗo deeƴira sabu mun hara hinde tinndini e gasugol ko Malaa'ikaajo on weltiniri lam kon". O Daali: "Maande maaɗa e gasugol ko weltiniraɗaa kon ko nde tawi a hattan-hattantaake wowlidude e yimɓe ɓen balɗe tati hara wanaa ñaw, ko woni, hara hiɗa wonndi e cellal e aafiya".
